On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

faq.a: Steelhead is a rural acreage community in the City of Mission, on the Stave Lake / Steelhead Road side west of the urban core — SnapStats lists it as an FVREB sub-area under Mission, and the live page describes larger rural lots and forested settings with access toward Stave Falls and Hayward Lake, distinct from the Stave Falls waterfront market (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: What sold in Steelhead in September 2026?
faq.a: Nothing, as published: detached recorded 0 listings and 0 solds, and Condos & Townhomes recorded 0 listings and 0 solds, so no sales ratio applies — an empty shelf in a small rural sub-area, not a value signal. At the Mission community level the detached median sale price was $814,000 and the Condos & Townhomes median was $430,000 (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Can a Steelhead acreage have a suite or a second dwelling?
faq.a: An in-house secondary suite is permitted inside a single family home if it is registered with the City (new suites need a building permit; a $63 annual suite fee plus utility fees applies), but a detached coach home or garden cottage is a secondary detached dwelling — on rural lots that generally requires the secondary-dwelling ("s") variant of the parcel's zone, which City material shows owners obtaining by rezoning (e.g., RU16 to RU16s).

faq.q: What recreation is Steelhead known for?
faq.a: BC Hydro's Hayward Lake recreation area — a hydroelectric reservoir and popular recreation area near Mission, with the Stave Lake boat launch and Ruskin Dam recreation area nearby — plus the Stave Falls Powerhouse visitor facilities; the City of Mission restricts parking on the roads leading to Hayward Lake at busy times.
